result.text: I could not find what part KX-3673 is for in the passages.
I could not find what part KX-6507 is for in the passages.
E-2194 means the Ashby tumble dryer’s factory reset was interrupted before its saved settings were cleared. Your previous preferences may still be active.
KX-9283 is the Wi-Fi module for the Ashby tumble dryer. It connects the dryer to the app.
KX-3107 is the voice pairing module for the Orrin heat pump.
Error E-7084 means the Vale fridge freezer’s vibration sensor has detected excessive movement while the compressor is running.
E-6292 means the cooker hood has detected an electrical insulation fault in its fan motor. Stop using it and switch off its power; have a qualified electrician assess it.
E-6076 means water has remained in the dishwasher’s base for more than three minutes after draining started. A blocked filter or kinked drain hose is the usual cause.
E-5107 means mains power was interrupted while the compressor was running. The heat pump pauses to protect the compressor during restart.
The passages do not say what error E-3865 means.
I could not find what part KX-3452 is for in the passages.
Part KX-3926 is the washable metal grease filter for the Fenwick cooker hood.
I could not find what error E-3873 means in the passages.
KX-7011 is the sealing strip fitted beneath the glass edge of the Corra induction hob.
E-4805 means the dishwasher’s digital warranty record is missing its purchase date, so the warranty cannot be confirmed automatically. It does not mean the warranty has expired.
KX-1639 is the supplied charging dock for the Mira robot vacuum.
E-6736 means the kettle lid’s locking clip isn’t holding the lid securely shut. If it’s cracked or broken, the lid needs replacing.
KX-9495 is the heating relay module for the Lumen smart thermostat.
Error E-3293 means the hob’s moisture sensor detected condensation beneath the control panel and stopped heating as a precaution.
I could not find part KX-8033 in the passages.
KX-9996 is the voice connection module in an Ashby tumble dryer.
E-7160 means the Orrin heat pump’s warranty record is missing its installation date. It’s a registration issue, not a heating fault, and doesn’t automatically mean the warranty has expired.
On the Halvard Home Fenwick cooker hood, E-1216 means the control board cannot detect the fan motor’s speed, so the hood stops the fan.
I could not find what part KX-5912 is for in the passages.
Error E-4021 means the dishwasher has not drained the water within three minutes. A blocked drain filter is the most common cause.
KX-2446 is the drain pump fitted to the Halvard Home Keel washing machine.
E-3946 means the Corra induction hob’s lid sensor has detected that the protective lid is not fully closed.
KX-5646 is the replacement cooling fan for the Corra induction hob.
I could not find what error E-6779 means in the passages.
KX-7896 is the Lumen thermostat’s room temperature sensor module.
I could not find what error E-9454 means in the passages.
KX-8645 is the removable filter for the Tessa dishwasher.
The passages do not identify part KX-8618.
KX-3056 is the wireless pairing module for the Brio kettle. It lets the kettle connect to the Halvard Home app so you can link a supported voice assistant.
I could not find what error E-8255 means in the passages.
I could not find what error E-5328 means in the passages.
I could not find what part KX-1377 is for in the passages.
E-9509 means the delay-start timer has lost its saved countdown. The dishwasher pauses rather than starting at an unexpected time.
KX-1060 is the power recovery control module for a Corra induction hob.
I could not find what error E-9215 means in the passages.
It supports a 2.4 GHz Wi‑Fi network.
The passages give conflicting warranty periods: one says two years from purchase, while another says 66 months from delivery. I couldn’t determine which applies to your kitchen vent fan.

Before leaving, run a wash to clear any dirty dishes. When it finishes, unload the dishwasher and let the interior cool. Clean the filter according to the user manual and wipe the door seals with a soft, damp cloth.

For an extended absence, switch off the electricity and close the dishwasher’s water supply valve. If it’s safe, leave the door slightly open to let moisture escape. If the cottage could freeze, ask a qualified installer about draining the appliance. On your return, restore the electricity and water, check for leaks, and then run a wash.

Leave clear instructions beside the appliance that match whether it’s a dryer or washing machine:

- **For an Ashby tumble dryer:** Clean the lint filter after every load, check care labels, don’t overload it, and keep the area around it clear. Ask visitors to stay in the property while it runs and let the full programme—including the cooling stage—finish.
- **For a Keel washing machine:** Check the inlet and drain hoses for leaks or damage, turn on the water supply before washing, choose a programme suited to the care labels, and measure detergent for the load and local water hardness. Before leaving, visitors should remove laundry, check the drum, wipe the door seal, switch off the machine and water supply, and leave the door slightly open while keeping children and pets away.

Frozen patches or ice are not normal. Do not start a programme. Switch the dishwasher off and contact Halvard Home support for advice before using it again. Don’t use boiling water or sharp tools to remove the ice.

Stop the programme, switch off the dryer and unplug it. Let it cool, then clean the lint filter, clear accessible air vents, and empty and refit the water tank if your model has one. Reconnect it and try the programme once. If the warning or error returns, stop using the dryer and contact Halvard Home support, noting exactly what light or code appeared. Do not remove panels or attempt internal repairs.

Switch off the hob using its controls, stop cooking, and let hot surfaces cool. Make sure the controls are clean and dry, with nothing covering them. If it’s safe to access the wall isolator, you can switch the power off for 60 seconds and then restore it.

If the error returns, leave the hob off and contact Halvard Home support. Note the exact message or which light flashes and when it happens. Don’t open the hob or attempt internal repairs.

Stop the dryer immediately and switch it off. Unplug it if it’s safe, and don’t run another cycle to test it. Leave it unplugged until it has cooled completely; then you can clean the lint filter and check that the external vents are clear. Don’t use it again until a qualified appliance technician has checked it. If there’s smoke or flame, keep the door closed, leave the property, and call 999.

Use the heating schedule to set the time you want heating to begin—not how long to wait. For example, if you want a one-hour delay from 18:00, set the start time to 19:00, choose your target temperature, and save. Make sure the schedule is enabled and set for the correct day. Heating will start only if the room is cooler than your target.
Keep the extractor running for 10 minutes after you finish cooking to clear lingering steam and smells.
Hire a qualified heat pump installer to disconnect, move and recommission your Orrin heat pump. Do not try to relocate it yourself.

Check that the extractor’s wall switch or fused spur is on, then try the light and fan controls to see whether the whole hood has lost power or just the display. Switch it off at the electrical supply for 60 seconds, then turn it back on and try again.

If the fan and light work but the screen stays blank, contact Halvard Home support and tell them which controls still respond. If nothing works, check whether other kitchen appliances have power. Don’t remove covers or touch internal wiring; arrange a qualified inspection if the problem continues.

To safely relocate your Ashby tumble dryer:

1. Switch it off, unplug it from the wall, and let it cool completely if it has been running. Pull the plug, not the cable.
2. Remove the laundry and clean the lint filter. Empty the water tank if fitted, then disconnect any drain or vent hose.
3. Plan a clear route and keep children and pets away. Secure the hoses and power cable so they cannot drag or catch.
4. Use two people and a suitable appliance trolley. Keep the dryer upright, and never lift it by the door, control panel, cable, or attached fittings. Protect the cabinet and secure the dryer during transport.
5. At the new location, set it on a firm, level floor and reconnect it according to its installation instructions. Check for damage before reconnecting.
6. Keep it disconnected for **38 hours after moving** before switching it on.
Yes. A factory reset of the Lumen smart thermostat clears saved Wi‑Fi details, heating schedules, and personal settings. You’ll need to reconnect it to Wi‑Fi and set up your preferences again.

Finish any wash or drying programme and empty the drum. Leave your appliance switched on and connected to home Wi‑Fi.

- **Keel washing machine:** In the Halvard Home app, select the machine and go to **Settings > Firmware update**.
- **Ashby tumble dryer:** On the dryer’s display, open **Settings > Software update > Check for updates**.

If an update is available, select **Install** and follow the instructions. Keep the appliance powered on during installation, and wait for confirmation that it’s complete before using it.

Send Halvard Home support your hob’s full model details and a clear photo of the part you want to replace, if you still have it. Include a short description of the part or its purpose if it’s missing, and ask them to confirm compatibility with your exact model.

First, make sure your Mira vacuum is online in the Halvard Home app and that you can start a cleaning from the app. Then, in your voice assistant’s app, add or link **Halvard Home** and sign in with the same account you used to set up Mira. Allow access and ask the assistant to discover devices. Give the vacuum a simple name, such as “Mira,” then try saying, “Start Mira.”

If it doesn’t appear, check its internet connection, unlink Halvard Home from the assistant app, and link it again.
The Brio kettle’s warranty lasts 47 months from the date of delivery. If you mean the guarantee for a paid repair, that lasts 122 days.

1. Switch it off at the mains and let the glass cool completely. Remove cookware and loose items. If it is hardwired, have a qualified electrician isolate and disconnect it—don’t pull or cut the cable.
2. Have the installer release any fixings or seals; don’t try to lift it while it is secured to the worktop. Clear the route and use two people or suitable lifting equipment.
3. Support the appliance by its body or the handling points in its installation instructions—not by the cable, controls or glass edges. Protect the glass with suitable packaging and cushioning, and keep objects off it.
4. Do not tilt the Corra hob more than 54 degrees while carrying it. After moving it, have a qualified installer check and reconnect it safely before use. The instructions also require waiting 17 hours before switching it on.

Make sure the controller is powered on and your phone is connected to your home Wi‑Fi. Turn on Bluetooth, keep the phone near the controller, and allow the companion app any requested Bluetooth, nearby-device, or local-network permissions. Then fully close and reopen the app and try adding the controller again. If it still doesn’t appear, restart your phone and check for app updates. Avoid factory resetting it as an initial step; contact support if the problem continues.

Warm, moist cooking air can condense on the hood’s cold surfaces, especially in chilly weather or when the extraction duct passes through an unheated space. Run the hood while cooking and for 10 minutes afterwards, and keep ventilation openings clear. If water keeps dripping, stop using the hood and contact Halvard Home support.

If you’re leaving food inside, keep the fridge freezer running, set the fridge to 4°C and the freezer to −18°C, and make sure both doors close fully. Remove anything that may expire before you return.

If you’re emptying it for the months you’ll be away, switch it off and unplug it before cleaning. Remove all food, let any ice thaw, clean with warm water and mild detergent, and dry it thoroughly. Leave both doors ajar to help prevent smells and mould. When you return, let it reach its set temperatures before adding food.

Stop the programme and note the exact error code. Switch the washer off and unplug it for five minutes, using dry hands. Check that the door is fully closed and no clothing is caught in the seal; don’t force the door open if water remains inside. If the fault returns, stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support, telling them the code and when it appeared.

To prepare your Keel washer for a move:

1. Switch it off and unplug it, then turn off the water supply and disconnect the hoses. Use dry hands, and keep a towel and shallow tray nearby for remaining water.
2. Drain the machine as described in the user manual, empty the drum, and leave it dry.
3. Refit the original transport bolts according to the manual. If they’re missing, contact Halvard Home before moving the washer.
4. Secure the hoses and cable so they won’t trail, stretch, or get trapped. Keep the washer upright where possible, and use two people or suitable lifting equipment—don’t carry it alone.
5. Plan a clear route and protect the floor without creating a slipping hazard.

At the new house, remove the transport bolts before using the washer. Follow the installation instructions and wait 44 hours before switching it on.

Icy buildup or condensation can form when warm, moist air gets inside—often because the doors are opened frequently, food is uncovered, or a door seal is not closing properly. Cover food, check that nothing blocks the doors, clean and dry the seals, and keep the air vents clear.

Switch on the child lock by holding the power button for 3 seconds while the vacuum is on and stationary. A sound confirms it’s active. This locks the vacuum’s buttons, but scheduled cleaning and app controls remain available, so it may still start automatically. Keep your toddler away while it’s moving.
Your refrigerator needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
Check the power supply first: make sure the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. You can test the socket with a working lamp.

To return your Mira robot vacuum to its original setup:

1. Place it on its plugged-in charging dock.
2. Press and hold the **Power** and **Home** buttons together for 10 seconds.
3. Release them when you hear the reset announcement.
4. Leave the vacuum on the dock while it restarts.

Then add it again in the Halvard Home app and reconnect it to Wi-Fi. The reset removes saved Wi-Fi details, maps, and cleaning schedules, which you’ll need to set up again.

Provide the full model details from the extractor’s rating label and the name or description of the part you need. If you’re unsure what it’s called, send a clear photo of the existing part. Ask support to confirm compatibility, availability, the total price including delivery, and the expected delivery time before ordering.

Set your heating to around 19°C, then adjust it for comfort. Use a schedule that fits your routine, with a small overnight or away-from-home reduction rather than switching a heat pump off completely. Lowering your usual temperature by 1°C can reduce energy use, as long as everyone stays warm enough. Keep vents and thermostats unobstructed, and avoid turning the temperature up sharply to heat a room faster.

Switch off the automatic floor cleaner and remove it from its charging dock. Check the lid’s edges, hinges and catch for dust, hair or small objects, and wipe accessible edges with a dry, soft cloth. Make sure the dust bin is seated correctly and nothing sticks up above it. Lower the lid gently—don’t force it. If it still won’t stay down or a hinge or catch looks damaged, stop using the cleaner and contact Halvard Home support.

Contact Halvard Home customer support with your Keel washer’s model details, a description of the part, and a clear photo of the appliance’s identification label. If you have the part already, photograph it too. Tell support it’s an extra item, and ask them to confirm it fits your exact model, is available, and what the total price including delivery and expected delivery time will be.

Have a qualified heat pump installer disconnect your old heat pump and safely recover its refrigerant. Then arrange recycling through your replacement installer or contact your local council for a service that accepts heat pumps. Check collection arrangements first, keep the disconnected unit upright and away from children, and use a licensed waste carrier if transporting it yourself. Do not put it in household rubbish or dismantle it.

Unplug the teapot and let it cool completely before checking inside. Use a descaler labelled as suitable for kettles, following its package instructions; don’t mix cleaning products or fill above the maximum mark. Empty it and rinse thoroughly with fresh water, then boil and discard a full kettle of fresh water twice before making drinks. Keep the base, plug and outside dry, and never immerse the teapot in water.

Switch it off and unplug it, then let it cool completely. Lift it off the base and dry the outside; check whether water has run down from the spout or lid, and make sure it wasn’t filled above the MAX mark. If water keeps collecting underneath, stop using it and contact Halvard Home support. Never immerse the base or try to repair it yourself.

Check for anything blocking the door: move food and packaging away from the shelf edges, push drawers fully in, and make sure shelves are seated correctly. Clean and dry the door seal and the surface it touches, then check for ice preventing the door from closing. Don’t force the door shut or chip ice with a sharp tool. If it still hangs unevenly or the seal is damaged, contact Halvard Home support.
First, check the cooker hood’s power supply: make sure its wall switch or fused connection switch is on, and check that any plug is fully inserted if you can reach it safely.

First check that the controller’s power supply is on. If there’s a clearly labelled wall switch, make sure it’s on; if it already is, switch it off for 30 seconds, then turn it back on. Don’t remove the cover or touch wiring. If it remains unresponsive, contact Halvard Home support.

Pause the programme and wait for the drum to stop. If the door unlocks, spread heavy items evenly around the drum, then restart the programme—don’t force the door open. Check that all four feet are firmly on a hard, level floor and the machine doesn’t rock. If it was newly installed, check the installation guide to make sure the transit bolts were removed. If strong vibration continues, stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support.

On your Tessa dishwasher, open **Settings** on the control panel, select **Firmware update**, then **Check for updates**. If an update is available, select **Install** and follow the display instructions.

Before starting, make sure the dishwasher is connected to Wi-Fi, switched on, empty, and not running a wash programme. Keep the power and Wi-Fi connected during installation, and wait for the display to confirm it’s complete before starting a wash.

Stop the cycle and turn off the water supply tap. Unplug the machine only if the plug and surrounding area are dry—never touch a wet plug or socket. Once safe, wipe up the water and check visible inlet-hose connections, whether the drain hose has slipped out, and whether excess detergent is causing water to run from the drawer.

Do not run another cycle while the cause is unclear. If the hoses appear secure or water is coming from beneath the casing, contact Halvard Home support.

Stop cleaning and switch off the vacuum. If the dock or plug is wet, switch off the mains socket before handling it. Remove and empty the water tank, check that its filler cap is fully closed and inspect the tank and outlet for cracks. Dry the tank and vacuum’s underside with a cloth; don’t rinse the vacuum body or return it to the dock while wet.

If the tank is cracked or it leaks again after you refit it securely, stop using the mopping function and contact Halvard Home support.

Before first use:

- Read the supplied installation instructions and check that the space meets the required clearances.
- Remove all packaging from inside and around the drum.
- Place the dryer indoors on a firm, level floor, then adjust its feet so it stands steadily without rocking.
- Keep ventilation openings clear. Connect any vent hose or water drainage as described in the instructions.
- Plug the dryer directly into a suitable earthed wall socket—do not use an extension lead. Keep the plug accessible and the lead free from trapping or damage.
- Wipe the empty drum with a soft, damp cloth.

Do not connect the dryer if its cable or other parts appear damaged, or if you are unsure about the electrical supply. Seek qualified help.

Make sure the heat pump is switched on and your phone is connected to your home Wi-Fi. Then try, in order:

1. Move your phone closer to the heat pump.
2. Allow the app any requested Bluetooth or local network access in your phone’s settings.
3. Turn your phone’s Wi-Fi off for 10 seconds, then back on.
4. Close and reopen the app, then try adding the device again.
5. Check the app store for an update.

If it still doesn’t appear, contact Halvard Home support and tell them your phone model and what happens when you try to connect.

Yes. Water beneath the outdoor unit during or shortly after defrosting is usually normal: melting ice drains away and can form a puddle. Monitor it to see whether it stops. If water runs continuously, comes from a pipe joint, or appears beneath an indoor unit, arrange an inspection by a qualified heat pump engineer.
No. The Brio kettle does not have a timer or delay-start setting; you need to switch it on manually.
The Fenwick cooker hood needs a 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi network. It cannot connect to a network set to 5 GHz only.

Heat pumps generally heat rooms gradually, and their radiators may feel cooler than boiler-heated radiators. This does not necessarily mean there is a fault. Cold weather or a defrost cycle can also temporarily reduce heat output.
Yes. A gentle rumbling or hissing sound while the Brio kettle heats is usually normal.

Make sure the washing machine is switched on and your phone is nearby. Connect your phone to a **2.4 GHz Wi‑Fi network** (5 GHz won’t work for setup), turn on Bluetooth, and allow the app to access nearby devices. Close and reopen the app, then try adding the machine again and follow the in-app pairing instructions.

If it still doesn’t appear, restart your phone and router and retry once Wi‑Fi is available. If the problem continues, contact Halvard Home support with your phone model and where setup stops.

Stop the programme, switch off and unplug the dryer, and let it cool. Clean and securely refit the fluff filter; if your model has a water tank, empty and refit it. Check that no clothing is trapped in the door, then close it firmly.

Reconnect the dryer and try the programme again. If the light keeps flashing, stop using the appliance and contact Halvard Home support. Tell them which light is flashing and when it appears.

A rattling, thumping or scraping noise can be caused by loose items such as coins or keys, metal zips or buttons, an uneven load, or the dryer touching nearby furniture. Stop the programme, switch off and unplug the dryer, then let the drum cool before checking for loose items and redistributing bulky laundry. Check that the dryer is level and not touching a wall or cupboard. Don’t remove panels or reach underneath.

If the noise continues or you hear loud grinding, stop using the dryer and contact Halvard Home support.

Switch off and unplug the machine, and let any hot water cool completely. Open the lower front filter flap with towels and a shallow tray underneath, then loosen the filter slowly so trapped water can drain. Remove debris, rinse the filter, and refit it securely. Run a drain cycle or short rinse to check that it drains properly and does not leak. If slow draining continues or you notice a leak, stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support.

Switch the dryer off at the socket before unplugging it. Use a torch to check the area. If it’s safe to open the door, carefully remove the laundry—it may be hot—and spread it out so heat can escape.

Once the power supply is stable, plug the dryer back in and switch it on. Check the laundry and restart a suitable programme if more drying is needed. If you notice a burning smell or visible damage, leave the dryer unplugged and contact Halvard Home support.

Water underneath your Vale fridge freezer may be from a spill, a blocked defrost drain, or a door that isn’t closing properly. It can also be caused by an incorrectly fitted filter or a damaged connection. If the leak returns after you wipe it up and restart the appliance, contact Halvard Home support.

Make sure the dishwasher is switched on and your phone is connected to your home Wi-Fi. Then:

1. Move your phone close to the dishwasher.
2. Turn on Bluetooth and allow any nearby-device or location permissions the app requests.
3. Avoid using a guest Wi-Fi network.
4. Close the app completely, reopen it, and try adding the dishwasher again.
5. If it still doesn’t appear, switch the dishwasher off at the mains for 30 seconds, then turn it back on.

If the problem continues, contact Halvard Home support and tell them which steps you tried.
Recycle your old Halvard Home Corra induction hob as electrical equipment. Do not put it in your household rubbish bin.

A rattling or banging noise can be caused by loose objects in the drum, an uneven load, or the machine not being level. Pause the programme and wait for the drum to stop and the door to unlock—never force it open. Spread heavy items evenly around the drum, check for coins, keys, or other loose objects, and gently check whether the machine rocks. If it was newly installed, confirm that the transit bolts were removed.

Make sure the kettle is not heating, then press and hold the lock button for three seconds. The lock indicator lights up when the controls are locked.

To switch it off, press and hold the same button for three seconds, until the indicator goes out.

A factory reset erases saved heating schedules and temperature preferences, so note them down first.

1. Make sure the heat pump is on and no warning is displayed.
2. On the controller, open **Settings** → **System** → **Factory reset**.
3. Select **Confirm** and keep the power connected while the controller restarts.
4. When the home screen returns, check the date and time, then re-enter your preferred temperatures and schedule.

If **Factory reset** is unavailable or the controller does not restart, contact Halvard Home support. Don’t open the unit or change installer settings to force a reset.

Connect the fridge freezer to your home Wi-Fi and ensure it has a steady power supply. On the control panel, open **Settings**, select **Software update**, then choose **Check for updates**. If an update is available, follow the on-screen instructions.

Keep the appliance switched on and don’t unplug or restart it during installation. Keep the doors closed as much as possible, and wait for the control panel to confirm the update is complete. If it fails, check your Wi-Fi connection before trying again.

Make sure the kettle has finished boiling and cooled down. Then:

1. Place it securely on its base.
2. Plug the base into a wall socket and switch the socket on.
3. Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds.
4. Release it when the indicator light flashes twice. This confirms the reset is complete.

Unplug the kettle and let it cool completely. Empty it, open the lid, and gently remove the filter from behind the spout—don’t force it if it’s stuck. Rinse it under warm running water and use a soft brush to loosen deposits. For stubborn build-up, soak it in warm water for 10 minutes, then brush gently and rinse thoroughly. Refit the filter securely before using the kettle. Avoid abrasive cleaners and metal brushes.

To factory reset your Corra induction hob:

1. Remove all cookware and let the cooking zones cool. Make sure the control panel is clean and dry.
2. Switch the hob off with the power button, but leave its electrical supply connected.
3. Press and hold the timer and minus buttons together for five seconds.
4. Release them when you hear a beep.
5. Press the power button once to confirm the reset.

Switch the hob back on and re-enter any preferences you want. If the controls don’t respond or the reset doesn’t complete, contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove the hob or open its casing.

Make sure the hob has power and your phone is nearby. Turn on Bluetooth and Wi‑Fi, and allow the app to access Bluetooth, nearby devices, and local network if prompted. Close the app completely, wait 30 seconds, then reopen it. Follow the app’s instructions to put the hob into pairing mode and search again. If it was connected before, check whether it appears under another account or home. If it still won’t appear, contact Halvard Home support with your phone model and where setup stops.

If the machine is damp from condensation, wipe the outside with a soft, dry cloth and improve ventilation. Check nearby hoses and connections; recurring puddles may indicate a leak.

If you notice frost, stop using the machine. Switch it off and unplug it only if your hands, plug and socket are dry. Let the machine and room warm naturally—don’t use boiling water, a hairdryer or a portable heater. Once it has thawed, check for visible leaks. If frost returns or you find damaged hoses, contact Halvard Home support before using it again.

To switch the child lock on, press and hold the padlock button for three seconds. The padlock light will come on to confirm it is active.

To switch it off, press and hold the same button for three seconds. Wait for the padlock light to go out before choosing a programme or changing a setting.
Yes. An unusual vibration may come from a loose wall fixing or nearby heating equipment rather than the thermostat itself.

Use the lowest power setting that keeps the food cooking as needed, and turn the heat down to a gentle simmer once water boils. You can also:

- Keep a lid on the pan when the recipe allows.
- Use a flat-bottomed, induction-compatible pan that matches the cooking zone.
- Heat only the water you need.
- Avoid heating empty pans or preheating longer than necessary.
- Switch off each zone as soon as cooking is finished.
- If cooking slows too much, increase the power gradually rather than jumping to the highest setting.

Unusual vibration can be caused by something touching the unit, loose mounting points or an uneven base.

Switch the heat pump off using its normal controls. From a safe position, remove loose items leaning against it and clear leaves or debris around the outdoor unit. Don’t remove covers, reach through the grille or adjust mounting bolts.

If there’s no visible damage and the area is clear, restart it and listen from a safe distance. If the vibration continues, switch it off and contact Halvard Home support or a qualified installer. Keep it off if it shakes violently, moves on its base or makes a grinding noise.
I could not find a single purchase-date warranty period in the passages. They give conflicting terms: P1 says two years from purchase, while P2 says 40 months from delivery.
A 3-hour delay means the machine waits 3 hours before the wash begins; it does not mean the wash will finish in 3 hours.

Switch off and unplug the washing machine, then turn off the water supply. Check the seal for splits, holes or areas pulled away from the door opening. **Do not use the machine if the seal is torn or leaking.**

Contact Halvard Home support with your machine’s model details and a clear photo of the damage. Ask them to confirm the replacement seal fits your machine before ordering. Have a qualified repair technician fit it, since an incorrectly fitted seal can leak.

Finish any wash programme, empty the drum and leave the machine switched on. Make sure it’s connected to your home Wi-Fi, then open the Halvard Home app and select your Keel washing machine. Go to **Settings > Firmware update**, tap **Install** if an update is available, and follow the instructions.

Keep the machine switched on and don’t unplug it or restart your router during installation. Wait for the app to confirm the update is complete before using the machine.

Switch off the electricity supply at the consumer unit and keep it off until the hood is securely fitted and all electrical work is complete. Have a suitably qualified installer assess the position and fit the hood, and use a competent electrician for fixed electrical connections.

Follow the hood’s installation guide for clearance above the hob—don’t guess, and check the cooking appliance’s requirements too. The hood must be at least 121 cm from a gas hob or open flame, within 220 cm of its socket, and positioned so the cable is not stretched, trapped or exposed to heat. Keep the socket accessible; don’t use an extension lead or adaptor.

Use fixings suitable for the wall, and check for concealed pipes, wiring and other services before drilling. Follow the guide for ducting, and don’t discharge air into a flue used by a fuel-burning appliance. Once installed, check the filters are seated correctly and test the fan and light. If the hood or its fittings appear damaged, or the installation seems unsafe, leave it disconnected and contact Halvard Home.

First add your Keel washing machine to the Halvard Home app and make sure it appears online. Then:

1. Open your voice assistant’s app and go to the section for adding devices, skills, or services.
2. Search for and select **Halvard Home**.
3. Sign in with the same Halvard Home account you use for the washing machine.
4. Allow account linking and ask the assistant to discover devices.
